chapter-8-3-hume-highway.title: CB DCP 2023 Ch 8.3 Hume Highway Enterprise Corridor (Amended April 2025), 42 pages

land_sentence.text: This clause applies to sites within Zone E3 Productivity Support that adjoin the Hume Highway.

4.1 Council may apply the storey limit (not including basements) shown in Figure 4b to land within Zone E3 Productivity Support only if it is satisfied that: (a) development will consolidate all adjoining lots shown edged with a heavy black line in Figure 4a into a single site
This clause applies to 324-326 Hume Highway, Bankstown.

Council may apply the storey limit (not including basements) shown in Figure 5a to the site at 139-159 Hume Highway in Greenacre only if it is satisfied that: (a) development will consolidate all the lots into a single site
This section of the DCP applies to the following properties as shown in Figure 6a below.

Council may apply the storey limit (not including basements) shown in Figure 7a to the site at 225-243A Hume Highway, 112 Northcote Road, and 24 Hillcrest Avenue in Greenacre only if it is satisfied that: (a) development will consolidate all the lots into a single site

Council may apply the storey limit (not including basements) shown in Figure 8a to the site at 315 Hume Highway and 177-183 Banksia Road in Bankstown only if it is satisfied that: (a) development will consolidate all the lots into a single site

land_sentence.text: Chapter 11.6 of this DCP applies to the former Potts Hill Reservoir site, Potts Hill as shown in Figure 1. It applies to residential development for dwelling houses, dual occupancies, attached dwellings, residential flat buildings and community housing development that are identified within specific areas shown on the Land Application Map.
